title: Machine learning classified multiple sclerosis and estimated disability progression from OCT and clinical data
summary: The study compared classifiers for multiple-sclerosis diagnosis using OCT measurements from 72 patients and 30 healthy controls, and separately modeled disability progression from patient records using EDSS outcomes. Results are retrospective and sample-limited.
ai_technology: Multiple machine-learning classifiers applied to OCT measurements and longitudinal clinical records.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Diagnostic evaluation included 72 patients with MS and 30 controls; progression prediction used clinical records and EDSS reference outcomes.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective, modest-sized cohorts; no prospective utility or deployment benefit demonstrated.
evidence.ai_role: Multiple machine-learning classifiers applied to OCT measurements and longitudinal clinical records.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
